name: God Accepting Me
overview: Scripture reveals that God’s acceptance of us is grounded in His love demonstrated through the giving of His only Son, Jesus Christ, so that whoever believes in Him receives eternal life (John 3:16). Jesus invites believers to trust in Him as the way to the Father, the source of truth and life (John 14:1, 6). This acceptance is further secured by the presence of the Holy Spirit, the Comforter who dwells with believers forever (John 14:16), and by the intimate relationship believers share with Christ, the true vine, under the care of the Father (John 15:1; 17:11).
